name: Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund
oneLiner: BENJI is the on-chain share token for Franklin Templeton's FOBXX, an SEC-registered U.S. government money market fund with a stable $1.00 NAV.
collateral: U.S. government securities, cash, and repurchase agreements held by the Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (FOBXX); '40 Act-registered money market fund custodied by BNY Mellon with Franklin Templeton as transfer agent and Benji as the on-chain share record
pegMechanism: Single fund, multi-chain BENJI token tracking FOBXX's stable $1.00 NAV; rebasing share count records distributed yield directly on-chain; subscriptions and redemptions are gated to KYC-verified Benji wallets with USD-wire and Benji-to-USDC settlement paths

notices.title: Multi-chain fund with limited on-chain telemetry
notices.message: BENJI is the multi-chain share token of Franklin Templeton's FOBXX money market fund. Pharos tracks the Ethereum, Stellar, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Aptos, Base, and Solana deployments; BNB Chain and Canton issuances are not yet integrated. Live reserves use a curated weekly snapshot of the official fund factsheet until an on-chain NAV oracle becomes available.

mintAuthority.summary: BENJI is the on-chain share record for Franklin Templeton's FOBXX SEC-registered government money market fund. The Ethereum ERC1967/UUPS proxy (MoneyMarketFund_V6 implementation) uses AccessControl: a single EOA (0xd8e680) holds both DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER, which gates mintShares(). Franklin Templeton acts as transfer agent; no permissionless mint exists.

controls.label: Franklin Templeton transfer-agent issuance
controls.evidence: Franklin Templeton operates Benji as FOBXX's transfer agent, recording share issuance and redemption on-chain and rebasing share counts for yield; transfers are restricted to KYC-verified holders and the issuer holds freeze/burn authority. No permissionless mint route exists.

controls.label: BENJI Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN + ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER — EOA 0xd8e680
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25296068 (0x181f8a4), hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd8e680848ebea3075f67f6c3d556e8e79742b357) = true and hasRole(ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER 0x07ebf0b970059cabb630855106f8ac3839be12b825572fd9473db811159837d9, same address) = true on proxy 0x3ddc84940ab509c11b20b76b466933f40b750dc9. eth_getCode = 0x (confirmed EOA). Both roles granted in deployment tx at block 0x13a2270. 0 RoleRevoked events. The contract's mintShares(address,uint256) function is gated by ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER. No proxy admin slot set; upgrade path controlled via admin role.

review.evidence: Ethereum verified at block 25296068: ERC1967/UUPS proxy (MoneyMarketFund_V6 implementation 0x20ca56f1). Single EOA 0xd8e680848ebea3075f67f6c3d556e8e79742b357 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ROLE_TOKEN_OWNER (the role that gates mintShares). Confirmed EOA via eth_getCode. 0 RoleRevoked events. No proxy admin slot. The confirmed issuer-EOA admin corroborates the Franklin Templeton transfer-agent model. Non-EVM chains (Stellar, Solana, Aptos) and other EVM deployments (Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Polygon) retain issuer-backend characterization — on-chain minter surfaces on those chains not independently verified but consistent with single-issuer model.
